chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir narrated to us from his uncle Abdullah ibn Amir, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Sulayman ibn Mihran, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father al-Husayn ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: O Ali! You are my brother, and I am your brother. O Ali! You are from me, and I am from you. O Ali! You are my deputy (wasi), my vicegerent (khalifa), and the Proof of Allah (Hujjat Allah) over my nation after me. Whoever aligns with you will be made happy, and whoever opposes you will be made wretched.

key_terms.تَوَلَّى: tawalla — to accept wilaya/authority, to become a follower or ally
key_terms.حُجَّة اللَّه: Hujjat Allah — the Proof of Allah; the Imam as God's definitive argument/authority over humanity
key_terms.خَلِيفَة: khalifa — vicegerent/caliph; the successor who carries the Prophet's authority
key_terms.عَادَى: adawa — to oppose, to show enmity
key_terms.وَصِيّ: wasi — deputy/executor, the one entrusted with authority after death; used specifically for Ali as the Prophet's designated successor

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say to Imam Ali about his authority and succession?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet Muhammad's direct declaration to Imam Ali (as), establishing his unique spiritual and political authority. Transmitted through a chain of five Imams, this narration affirms Ali as the Prophet's brother in faith, his appointed successor (wasi and khalifa), and the binding proof of God upon the Muslim community. The concluding formula — the happiness of Ali's followers and the wretchedness of his opponents — echoes prophetic statements found across both Sunni and Shia sources, underscoring the doctrinal centrality of Ali's authority in Shia Islam.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from his uncle `Abdullah b. `Amer from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Sulayman b. Mehran from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father Muhammad b. `Ali from his father `Ali b. al-Husayn from his father al-Husayn b. `Ali from his father `Ali b. Abi Talib (as). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: O `Ali! You are my brother, and I am your brother. O `Ali! You are from me, and I am from you. O `Ali! You are my deputy, my vicegerent (khalifa), and the Proof of Allah over my Nation after me. Whoever aligns with you will be made happy, and whoever opposes you will be made wretched.
